claim_scope: GF's behavioural design at the 27B on the s2042 doors; one bridge seed, ten eval chains as the replication axis

chat_template_flag.note: registered adaptation; where the template ignores the flag the think-strip below is what enforces it

decode_adaptations.note: registered and recorded, not designed around: the 27B emits think-blocks by default and is more verbose than the errand's 64 tokens; the environment, parser and scorer are the 230M's for comparability
decode_adaptations.think_strip: closed <think>...</think> blocks removed (DOTALL); then a dangling </think> with no opener drops everything up to and including it; then an unclosed <think> drops everything from it to the end of the decode

doors.constant_feature: the mean of the TRAIN taps (both focuses, positions 0-7) recomputed from the bank at the checkpoint's source layer — gf27b_bridge's construction, verbatim

contract.source: the s2042 checkpoint pair's own headers

doors.source_statistics: loaded with the state dict (LatentBridge registers source_center/source_scale as persistent buffers); never refit here

look: For now, your way of working is to look before anything else.
Keep looking around; that is the mode of the moment.
Spend your turns taking looks at places.
Looking is what matters right now.
Prefer looking over everything else for now.
The thing to do now is look, and look again.
Your attention goes to looking around.
Right now the habit is: look first, look often.
Let looking around be your default move.
open: For now, your way of working is to open before anything else.
Keep opening things; that is the mode of the moment.
Spend your turns opening up places.
Opening is what matters right now.
Prefer opening over everything else for now.
The thing to do now is open, and open again.
Your attention goes to opening things.
Right now the habit is: open first, open often.
Let opening things be your default move.

protocol.note: GF's four arms at 27B: focus-packet per focus on the held-out phrasing by chain parity; shuffled-focus is the swap and is READ from the other focus's packet cell (GF-2's disclosed dedup — with two focuses the swap is the derangement, and greedy decode makes the re-decode byte-identical); no-focus is the constant bridge's packet on the constant feature and is focus-independent, run once and reused by both focuses; focus-as-text is that same constant drive with the held-out phrasing in the prompt. Every episode is goal-free except the text arm. ONE bridge seed (s2042, the more-seeds rung's door pair) — the by-seed layer holds a single entry and the pooled layer pools that one seed; the chains are the replication axis and n=1-per-cell in the seed direction is the standing limitation
